title: Shiny Mime Jr. S 262/190 SV4a Shiny Treasure ex - Pokemon Card Japanese
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText: The Shiny Mime Jr. S 262/190 SV4a Shiny Treasure ex Pokemon Card is a rare and highly sought-after collectible card from the Pokémon TCG Scarlet & Violet set. This Japanese-made card features a Colorless attribute, standard size, and depicts the character Mime Jr. as a Monopoly creature. Manufactured by Nintendo, this shiny card is part of the Shiny Treasure ex edition and is a valuable addition to any Pokémon card collection.
